blind.B1: Yes, it has an exercise arm: GFP+ newborn-neuron nuclei from hippocampus, WT and F5KO mice, sedentary vs voluntary wheel running (S2.5.p1, S4.6.p1, Fig. 5 legend). All 17 sequenced samples carry genotype and exercise factors; the paper says the exercise effect was not detected, 'underpowered' (S2.5.p2).
blind.B2: Paper's main comparison: F5KO vs WT, 459 DEGs (S2.5.p2, Fig. 5c). Groups WT-sed 4, WT-run 4, F5KO-run 4, F5KO-sed 5 (Fig. 5 legend). No exercise DEG comparison is reported.
blind.B3: No repeated measures: one nuclei sample per mouse, 17 mice (descriptions s3035...s3386 all distinct). Genotype and running are between-animal factors. The metadata candidate key (exercise + title suffix) only numbers mice within each group and is not an animal.
blind.B4: Paper says only 'DESeq2 ... was used for normalization and to determine differentially expressed genes' (S4.21.p1); no statement of joint 4-group or pairwise fit, and the supplement is not available. Fig. 5b clusters all four groups together.
blind.B5: 'A total of 459 genes were differentially expressed between F5KO and WT newborn neurons (log_2FC > |1.5|, p-value < 0.05)' (S2.5.p2): raw p < 0.05, effect cutoff 1.5 written as '> |1.5|' (strict). Count 459 for F5KO vs WT; no exercise count.

checks.evidence: Series has a running vs sedentary factor (title / characteristics_ch1.3), run as 'exploratory' because the paper reports no exercise DEG set (S2.5.p2).

grp levels KO_Run 4, KO_Sed 5, WT_Run 4, WT_Sed 4 = Fig. 5 legend; no exclusions; primary exercise contrast is WT_Run vs WT_Sed, the within-genotype control (not a cross-cell control). Cross-cell contrasts are labelled as extra.
Contrasts recorded as treatment Run vs control Sed, KO vs WT; spec names grp_WT_Run_vs_WT_Sed, grp_KO_Run_vs_KO_Sed, geno_KO_vs_WT, ex_Run_vs_Sed_adj_geno.
One sample per mouse (17 distinct descriptions); packet key 'ex + suffix of title' links only 16/17 and only numbers mice within group; pairing_check r difference 0.021, p 0.07, not_supported.

Paper is silent (S4.21.p1). Analysis used joint ~grp (4 cells) for the cell contrasts, ~geno+ex for the exercise main effect and ~geno for the paper's pooled contrast; both joint and pooled fits are reported. Whether the paper fitted pairs or one model is open policy.

No batch, sort date or housing field in GEO; all males, running and sedentary mice both individually housed (S4.6.p1). Recorded as no confounder available. Caveat on Fndc5 counts higher in KO is stated in the study record.
File name says 'normalized' but integer_fraction 1.0 and column sums 1.08M-8.52M; treated as raw STAR counts with the reason and the rejected alternative recorded. DESeq2 on counts matches S4.21.p1.

Applied: pvalue < 0.05 and |log2FC| > 1.5, strict, as S2.5.p2; audit padj<0.05 also reported. No alternative rule in the packet table gives 459 (784 paper rule, 1241 for p<0.05 & |lfc|>1), so no silent substitution.

Pooled KO vs WT gives 784 under the paper rule vs paper 459, a 1.7-fold gap; the HANDBACK table shows both numbers but the recorded paper-data discrepancies list does not include this count gap. Exercise contrasts are not compared to the paper (none reported), which is correct.
checks.fix: Add a discrepancy entry: geno_KO_vs_WT 784 vs paper 459 under the same stated rule (likely different gene filter or DESeq2 version, S4.21.p1 vs pydeseq2), disposition 'count differs, not reconciled'.

checks.evidence: No stop or refusal in this case.

human_items: Open policy question: joint ~grp versus pairwise fits when the paper is silent (S4.21.p1). Both a joint model and a pooled ~geno model are reported here, so nothing is hidden, but the primary choice is unsettled.

FNDC5 counts are slightly higher in KO (log2FC +0.36); the study record notes it but genotype labels were not re-verified from data. A person may want to confirm the KO allele design (partial exon deletion with intronic nuclear reads).
summary: 该系列有跑步与久坐因素，运行为探索性路线是合适的，因为论文称运动效应检验功效不足、未报告运动 DEG。分组 4/4/4/5 与论文一致，主对比是 WT 内 Run 对 Sed，符号方向正确，阈值逐字采用（原始 p<0.05 且 |log2FC|>1.5）。唯一的小问题是合并 KO 对 WT 得到 784 个 DEG，而论文为 459，这个差异应补记为 discrepancy。
